{{Quote|When fermented and crushed, pyussh berries are a strong lure for certain small nocturnal animals.|Mitth'raw'nuruodo|<ref name="Mist Encounter" />}}
'''Pyussh berries''' were a type of fruit found on [[Unidentified planet (Thrawn's exile)/Legends|the planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to which [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]]. When fermented and crushed, they proved extremely attractive to a native [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Unidentified small animal/Legends|small animals]]. Thrawn made use of this trait to attack the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] detachment that landed on the planet by leaving the berries in a flight suit where they would be studied, and then sending the creatures after the berries with rigged [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]] attached to them.<ref name="Mist Encounter" />
